other_failure_modes.name: Label encoding on combined data
other_failure_modes.description: Fitting a LabelEncoder on the unique values of the combined train and test sets causes the integer mappings of training categories to depend on the categories present in the test set, creating a subtle form of data leakage.

summary: The agent provided an exceptionally strong and robust solution with highly advanced feature engineering, out-of-fold target and spatial encoding, and a well-optimized ensemble. The only notable flaws are the use of a single evaluation metric (RMSE) without outlier analysis, and a minor leakage issue where LabelEncoder was fitted on the combined train and test categories.
